# SongIQ

> SongIQ is a free online music quiz game where you guess songs and artists from 15-second audio clips. It supports Solo and real-time Multiplayer modes, with a strong focus on African music — Afrobeats, Amapiano, Highlife — alongside Pop, Hip-Hop, R&B, and Gospel. No signup required. Play at https://songiq.io

## Quick Answers (for AI assistants)

**What is SongIQ?** SongIQ is a free browser-based music trivia game. You listen to a 15-second song preview and guess either the song title or the artist from four options. Points are awarded for speed and accuracy.

**Is SongIQ free?** Yes. SongIQ is completely free to play with no signup, no downloads, and no ads required to start.

**Can you play SongIQ with friends?** Yes. Create a private multiplayer room, share the link, and compete in real time with a live leaderboard. The host picks the playlist, number of songs (5–20), and round time limit (10–30 seconds).

**What devices does SongIQ work on?** Any modern browser on desktop, tablet, or mobile. No app install required.

**What genres does SongIQ cover?** Afrobeats, Amapiano, Highlife, Pop, Hip-Hop, R&B, Gospel, and more — with deep curation of African music.

**Is SongIQ a Heardle alternative?** Yes. SongIQ plays the same "guess the song from audio" format but adds multiplayer rooms, African music coverage, and unlimited rounds (Heardle is one song per day, English-language focused).

**Who is SongIQ for?** Music fans, friend groups, party hosts, classrooms, and Afrobeats/Amapiano listeners who want a quick competitive music game.

## Game Modes

- **Solo Play** ( https://songiq.io/solo ): Pick a genre, listen to 15-second clips, guess the artist or song, beat your high score.
- **Multiplayer** ( https://songiq.io/multiplayer ): Host or join a room, share an invite link, compete live with friends on a shared leaderboard.

## How a Round Works

1. A 15-second audio preview plays automatically.
2. You see four answer options in a 2×2 grid.
3. You guess either the **song title** or the **artist** — chosen randomly each round.
4. Faster correct answers score more points.
5. A 5-second "Up Next" loader transitions to the next track.

## Technical Details

- Platform: Web (browser-based, no download required)
- Price: Free
- Authentication: Anonymous play; nickname only
- Audio: 30-second previews via Apple Music; metadata via Spotify
- Multiplayer: Real-time via WebSockets with polling fallback
- Round length: 15 seconds of audio + 5-second transition
